evaluationScope: 16个边缘输入的离线候选规划、路由与上下文理解；不访问真实数据或外部API，不给生产正确率结论。

sources.title: Task management overview

sources.title: Assign task lists to stores or employees

sources.boundary: 用于周期和门店身份的查重测试，不授权定时任务或批量指派。

sources.title: Automated Workflow Stages overview

sources.title: Unified review and approval overview

sources.title: What is the Punch List Workflow?
